onboardBody.ai: It answers questions about prices, routes and documents in your own language, and finds matching loads for you.
onboardBody.analytics: Which route pays better and which month is busier — the numbers show it, and you pick the next trip accordingly.
onboardBody.chats: Message cargo owners, drivers and dispatchers right here — what you agreed on stays in the chat.
onboardBody.contracts: Create the agreement from a ready template, both sides sign it, and it stays in your account for good.
onboardBody.documents: Licences, vehicle papers and permits are kept in one place — the system reminds you before they expire.
onboardBody.drivers: Add drivers to your base, assign them to vehicles and track their document expiry in one list.
onboardBody.finance: Who owes you and whom you owe — all split by currency, with a budget to keep spending in check.
onboardBody.jobs: Driver, dispatcher and forwarder vacancies are all here. Leave a CV and employers will find you themselves.
onboardBody.loads: On FURAM.UZ every posted load is in one list. Filter by route and vehicle type, then open the cargo owner's phone number.
onboardBody.map: Loads, free trucks, border crossings and roadside services on one map. You also calculate distance and trip costs here.
onboardBody.market: Trucks, trailers and spare parts are bought and sold here: post an ad or save what you need.
onboardBody.money: Money from each trip, driver payouts and road costs on one screen, every currency counted separately.
onboardBody.post: Posting a load takes a minute — it appears on the board and matching carriers contact you themselves.
onboardBody.post-truck: Post a free vehicle and cargo owners on that route will find you in search.
onboardBody.profile: An account with a photo, a second phone and company details looks more trustworthy — people pick you sooner.
onboardBody.queues: Put a vehicle in the border queue and watch the waiting time and crossing status right on your phone.
onboardBody.reports: Get trip, income and expense reports as PDF or Excel — send the same file to your accountant or your client.
onboardBody.roles: Every role has its own plan and you can see in advance which sections it opens — no need to pay for extras.
onboardBody.trips: Mark each trip stage by stage: loaded, on the way, delivered. Driver, cargo owner and dispatcher all see the same status.
onboardBody.trucks: Find a free vehicle for your load by route, tonnage and body type, then contact the driver directly.
onboardBody.trust: A rating after a finished job lifts both your scores — a trusted partner gets work faster.
